title: PI4K2A deficiency causes innate error in intracellular trafficking with developmental and epileptic-dyskinetic encephalopathy

reviewer.method: Full main text read including methods, all clinical descriptions, Table 1, discussion, captions, acknowledgements and references. Three figure images and all three Table 1 pages inspected. Each packet feature assessed separately. Supplement video held but not watched; no complete-paper claim.

audit.exposure_note: This actual reviewer saw aggregate benchmark results in the inherited conversation and HANDOFF.md before this reading assignment. No per-case ranking outputs were opened for these source reviews. Retrieval work exposed bibliographic identities and selected-case counts, not per-case inference ranks. This review is not blinded.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Packet fetal callosal onset is assigned to Family1 although Table1 and Patient2 text assign prenatal detection to Family2; exclusion of microcephaly conflicts with Family1 head circumference42cm,z−6.87 at follow-up. Both packets encode sensory-neuropathy absence although source says peripheral neuropathy Unknown. Omitted documented features include thumb contractures, sleep disturbance and constipation.
